Reviewer B claims: Severity: Low
Reviewer B claims: File: pkg/proxy/nftables/proxier.go (line 1939-1942)

Reviewer B claims: Description: The DNAT rule format was changed from "dnat ipX addr . port to" to "dnat to" with net.JoinHostPort(). While this is cleaner, there's no validation that all nftables versions support this format.
Reviewer B claims: Test Coverage
Reviewer B claims: Severity: Medium
Reviewer B claims: File: pkg/proxy/nftables/proxier_test.go

Reviewer B claims: Severity: Low
Reviewer B claims: File: pkg/proxy/nftables/proxier_test.go
Reviewer B claims: Description: The IPv4 and IPv6 test cases are nearly identical copies with just address changes. This could be refactored to reduce duplication.
Reviewer B claims: Backward Compatibility
Reviewer B claims: The DNAT rule format change could potentially break compatibility with older nftables versions. This should be verified.
Reviewer B claims: Performance Impact
Reviewer B claims: The additional IPv6 support could impact performance, though this would likely be minimal. No benchmarks are provided.

Reviewer B claims: Add more test cases for IPv6 edge cases
